items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I recommended her to, uh, you know, to the club... Betty Carter came in... I stayed with her maybe eight days.

ctx.x: What, what … other than Howard, were you doing … when you were in Howard, what was the bill you were on? It wasn't just Art Blakey.
No, they would have a comedian and uh probably somebody like uh either Ray Charles, Betty Carter, those kind of shows, jazz shows.
And what other … Were you doing the same thing in Baltimore or …
